competences.description: Attacks with a spinning punch and stuns the enemy for 1 turn with a 50% chance. The damage of this attack increases according to your MAX HP.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Increases the critical rate for 2 turns and counterattacks when attacked. The Attack Bar is increased by 50%, and the damage you receive will be reduced by half when you get attacked while this skill is on cooldown.

effets.description: The target's Critical Rate will be increased by 30%.
When attacked, the target will counterattack to inflict 75% of the Attack Power as damage.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
Decreases damage received by a certain amount

competences.description: Absorbs the Attack Bar by 50% if you attack a monster with same or lower HP status compared to yours. Recovers your HP by 50% of the damage dealt if you attack a monster that has better HP status than yours. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself
effets.note: If Self HP % lower than target

effets.description: Heal that affects only the monster who cast the skill
effets.note: If Self HP % greater than target
